claims.statement: Grand Empress Dowager Bo and Empress Bo are distinct

sourceDate.text: 拜禮為楚王…文王立三年

units.zh: 楚元王劉交者，高祖之同母少弟也，字游。
units.en: Liu Jiao, King Yuan of Chu, was the youngest brother of Emperor Gaozu by the same mother, and bore the courtesy name You.
units.literal: King Yuan of Chu, Liu Jiao, was Gaozu's younger brother by the same mother, styled You.

units.zh: 高祖兄弟四人，長兄伯，伯蚤卒。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu had four brothers in all. The eldest, Bo, died young.
units.literal: Gaozu had four brothers: the eldest was Bo, who died young.

units.zh: 始高祖微時，嘗辟事，時時與賓客過巨嫂食。
units.en: In the early days, when Gaozu was still a man of humble station, he would shirk his duties and often bring guests to dine at his eldest brother's wife's home.
units.literal: When Gaozu was still of humble status, he once avoided official duties and frequently went with guests to eat at his elder brother's wife's house.

units.zh: 嫂厭叔，叔與客來，嫂詳為羹盡，櫟釜，賓客以故去。
units.en: His sister-in-law grew tired of her brother-in-law. Whenever he arrived with guests, she would pretend the stew had run out and scrape the pot loudly, so the guests would take their leave.
units.literal: The sister-in-law disliked her husband's younger brother. When he came with guests, she pretended the stew was gone and scraped the pot, so the guests left.

units.zh: 已而視釜中尚有羹，高祖由此怨其嫂。
units.en: But when they looked in the pot afterward, there was still plenty of stew. From that day on, Gaozu bore a grudge against his sister-in-law.
units.literal: Later, when they checked the pot, there was still stew left. From this, Gaozu resented his sister-in-law.

units.zh: 及高祖為帝，封昆弟，而伯子獨不得封。
units.en: When Gaozu became emperor and enfeoffed his brothers, Bo's son alone received no fief.
units.literal: When Gaozu became emperor, he enfeoffed his brothers, but Bo's son alone did not receive an enfeoffment.

units.zh: 太上皇以為言，高祖曰：「某非忘封之也，為其母不長者耳。」
units.en: The Retired Emperor raised the matter, and Gaozu replied, "It is not that I forgot to grant him a fief—it is because his mother was no woman of virtue."
units.literal: The Supreme Emperor spoke of this, and Gaozu said, "It is not that I forgot to enfeoff him; it is because his mother was not virtuous."

units.zh: 於是乃封其子信為羹頡侯。
units.en: He then enfeoffed Bo's son Xin as the Marquis of Gengjie.
units.literal: Therefore, he enfeoffed Bo's son Xin as Marquis of Gengjie.

units.zh: 而王次兄仲於代。
units.en: His second brother, Zhong, was made King of Dai.
units.literal: He then established his second brother Zhong as king in Dai.

units.zh: 高祖六年，已禽楚王韓信於陳，乃以弟交為楚王，都彭城。
units.en: In the sixth year of Gaozu's reign, having captured Han Xin, the King of Chu, at Chen, the emperor appointed his brother Jiao as King of Chu, with his capital at Pengcheng.
units.literal: In Gaozu's sixth year, after capturing the Chu king Han Xin at Chen, he made his brother Jiao King of Chu, with his capital at Pengcheng.

units.zh: 即位二十三年卒，子夷王郢立。
units.en: After twenty-three years on the throne, he died, and his son Ying succeeded him as King Yi.
units.literal: He reigned for twenty-three years and died. His son, King Yi Ying, succeeded him.

units.zh: 夷王四年卒，子王戊立。
units.en: King Yi reigned for four years before his death, and his son Wu succeeded him.
units.literal: King Yi reigned for four years and died. His son, King Wu, succeeded him.

units.zh: 王戊立二十年，冬，坐為薄太后服私姦，削東海郡。
units.en: In the twentieth year of King Wu's reign, during winter, he was found guilty of committing adultery during the mourning period for Empress Dowager Bo, and the commandery of Donghai was stripped from him.
units.literal: King Wu reigned for twenty years. In winter, he was convicted of committing adultery while mourning Empress Bo, and Donghai commandery was stripped from him.

units.zh: 春，戊與吳王合謀反，其相張尚、太傅趙夷吾諫，不聽。
units.en: In spring, King Wu of Chu joined the King of Wu in a conspiracy to rebel. His chancellor Zhang Shang and Grand Tutor Zhao Yiwu remonstrated with him, but he refused to listen.
units.literal: In spring, King Wu joined the King of Wu in conspiring to rebel. His chancellor Zhang Shang and tutor Zhao Yiwu advised against it, but he would not listen.

units.zh: 戊則殺尚、夷吾，起兵與吳西攻梁，破棘壁。
units.en: Wu had Shang and Yiwu executed, raised his troops, and marched west with the forces of Wu against Liang, breaching the fortifications at Jibi.
units.literal: King Wu then executed Shang and Yiwu, raised troops, and marched west with the King of Wu against Liang, breaking through Jibi.

units.zh: 至昌邑南，與漢將周亞夫戰。
units.en: They advanced as far south as Changyi, where they engaged the Han general Zhou Yafu in battle.
units.literal: They reached south of Changyi and fought with the Han general Zhou Yafu.

units.zh: 漢絕吳楚糧道，士卒饑，吳王走，楚王戊自殺，軍遂降漢。
units.en: The Han forces cut off the supply lines of Wu and Chu. The soldiers starved. The King of Wu fled, and King Wu of Chu took his own life. The army then surrendered to Han.
units.literal: Han cut off Wu and Chu's supply lines. The soldiers grew hungry. The King of Wu fled. King Wu of Chu committed suicide. The army surrendered to Han.

units.zh: 漢已平吳楚，孝景帝欲以德侯子續吳，以元王子禮續楚。
units.en: After Han had pacified Wu and Chu, Emperor Jing wished to restore the line of Wu through the son of the Marquis of De, and the line of Chu through King Yuan's son Liu Li.
units.literal: After Han pacified Wu and Chu, Emperor Jing wanted to continue Wu with the son of Marquis De, and continue Chu with King Yuan's son Liu Li.

units.zh: 竇太后曰：「吳王，老人也，宜為宗室順善。
units.en: Empress Dowager Dou said, "The King of Wu was an elder of the realm. He should have been a model of obedience and virtue among the imperial clan.
units.literal: Empress Dou said: "The King of Wu was an old man, he should have been compliant and virtuous within the imperial clan.

units.zh: 今乃首率七國，紛亂天下，柰何續其後！」
units.en: Instead, he took the lead in rallying seven states to throw the realm into chaos—how can we perpetuate his line!"
units.literal: Now he was the first to lead the seven states in throwing the realm into chaos—how can we continue his descendants!"

units.zh: 不許吳，許立楚後。
units.en: The request for Wu was denied, but permission was granted to continue the line of Chu.
units.literal: Wu was not allowed, but Chu was permitted to establish descendants.

units.zh: 是時禮為漢宗正。
units.en: At that time, Li was serving as the Director of the Imperial Clan for the Han court.
units.literal: At this time Li served as Han's Director of the Imperial Clan.

units.zh: 乃拜禮為楚王，奉元王宗廟，是為楚文王。
units.en: Li was then appointed King of Chu to carry on the ancestral sacrifices of King Yuan, and he became known as King Wen of Chu.
units.literal: Li was appointed King of Chu to maintain King Yuan's ancestral temples, and became King Wen of Chu.

units.zh: 文王立三年卒，子安王道立。
units.en: King Wen reigned for three years before his death. His son Dao succeeded him as King An.
units.literal: King Wen reigned for three years and died. His son, King An Dao, succeeded him.

units.zh: 安王二十二年卒，子襄王注立。
units.en: King An reigned for twenty-two years and died. His son Zhu succeeded him as King Xiang.
units.literal: King An reigned for twenty-two years and died. His son, King Xiang Zhu, succeeded him.

units.zh: 襄王立十四年卒，子王純代立。
units.en: King Xiang reigned for fourteen years and died, and his son Chun took the throne.
units.literal: King Xiang reigned for fourteen years and died. His son, King Chun, succeeded him.

units.zh: 王純立，地節二年，中人上書告楚王謀反，王自殺，國除，入漢為彭城郡。
units.en: After King Chun took the throne, in the second year of the Dijie era, a palace attendant submitted a memorial accusing the King of Chu of plotting rebellion. The king took his own life, the state was abolished, and its territory became the Pengcheng commandery under Han.
units.literal: King Chun ascended the throne. In the second year of the Dijie era, a palace attendant submitted a memorial accusing the King of Chu of plotting rebellion. The king committed suicide. The state was abolished and became Pengcheng commandery of Han.

units.zh: 趙王劉遂者，其父高祖中子，名友，謚曰「幽」。
units.en: Liu Sui, King of Zhao—his father was the middle son of Emperor Gaozu, named You, who was given the posthumous title of You, 'the Secluded.'
units.literal: King Zhao Liu Sui—his father was Gaozu's middle son, whose personal name was You and whose posthumous title was You, "the Secluded."

units.zh: 幽王以憂死，故為「幽」。
units.en: King You died of grief, and so received the posthumous name 'the Secluded.'
units.literal: King You died of sorrow, hence "You."

units.zh: 高后王呂祿於趙，一歲而高后崩。
units.en: Empress Dowager Gao installed Lü Lu as King of Zhao, but within a year she passed away.
units.literal: Empress Gao established Lü Lu as king in Zhao, and after one year Empress Gao passed away.

units.zh: 大臣誅諸呂呂祿等，乃立幽王子遂為趙王。
units.en: The great ministers put to death the Lu clansmen, including Lu Lu, and then established Sui, son of King You, as King of Zhao.
units.literal: The ministers executed the various Lü clansmen including Lü Lu, and established King You's son Sui as King of Zhao.

units.zh: 孝文帝即位二年，立遂弟辟彊，取趙之河閒郡為河閒王，（以）［是］為文王。
units.en: In the second year after Emperor Wen took the throne, he established Sui's younger brother Piqiang as King of Hejian, carving out the Hejian commandery from Zhao for this purpose. He became known as King Wen.
units.literal: In the second year of Emperor Wen's reign, he established Sui's younger brother Piqiang, taking Zhao's Hejian commandery to make him King of Hejian, who became King Wen.

units.zh: 立十三年卒，子哀王福立。
units.en: He reigned for thirteen years and died. His son Fu succeeded him as King Ai.
units.literal: He reigned for thirteen years and died. His son, King Ai Fu, succeeded him.

units.zh: 一年卒，無子，絕後，國除，入于漢。
units.en: He reigned for just one year before dying without an heir. The line was extinguished, the state abolished, and the territory reverted to Han.
units.literal: He reigned for one year and died without sons. The line was extinguished. The state was abolished and reverted to Han.

units.zh: 遂既王趙二十六年，孝景帝時坐晁錯以適削趙王常山之郡。
units.en: After Sui had been King of Zhao for twenty-six years, in Emperor Jing's time, because of Chao Cuo's plan to reduce the feudal domains, the commandery of Changshan was stripped from his domain.
units.literal: Sui had been king of Zhao for twenty-six years when, in Emperor Jing's time, on account of Chao Cuo's policy of reducing the feudal domains, the Changshan commandery was stripped from the Zhao king.

units.zh: 吳楚反，趙王遂與合謀起兵。
units.en: When Wu and Chu rose in rebellion, King Sui of Zhao joined the conspiracy and raised his own troops.
units.literal: When Wu and Chu rebelled, King Zhao Sui conspired with them and raised troops.

units.zh: 其相建德、內史王悍諫，不聽。
units.en: His chancellor Jiande and Interior Minister Wang Han remonstrated with him, but he would not listen.
units.literal: His chancellor Jiande and interior minister Wang Han advised against it, but he wouldn't listen.

units.zh: 遂燒殺建德、王悍，發兵屯其西界，欲待吳與俱西。
units.en: Sui had Jiande and Wang Han burned alive, deployed troops to garrison his western border, and planned to wait for the forces of Wu before advancing west together.
units.literal: Sui burned and killed Jiande and Wang Han, sent troops to garrison his western border, and wished to wait for Wu to advance west together.

units.zh: 北使匈奴，與連和攻漢。
units.en: He dispatched envoys northward to the Xiongnu, seeking an alliance to jointly attack Han.
units.literal: He sent envoys north to the Xiongnu, allied with them, and planned to attack Han.

units.zh: 漢使曲周侯酈寄擊之。
units.en: Han dispatched Li Ji, the Marquis of Quzhou, to attack him.
units.literal: Han sent Marquis Quzhou Li Ji to attack him.

units.zh: 趙王遂還，城守邯鄲，相距七月。
units.en: King Sui of Zhao withdrew and fortified Handan. The two sides held each other at bay for seven months.
units.literal: King Zhao Sui returned and defended Handan. They confronted each other for seven months.

units.zh: 吳楚敗於梁，不能西。
units.en: Wu and Chu were defeated at Liang and could advance no further west.
units.literal: Wu and Chu were defeated at Liang and could not advance west.

units.zh: 匈奴聞之，亦止，不肯入漢邊。
units.en: When the Xiongnu learned of this, they too held back and refused to cross into Han territory.
units.literal: The Xiongnu heard about this and also stopped, refusing to enter Han territory.

units.zh: 欒布自破齊還，乃并兵引水灌趙城。
units.en: Luan Bu, returning from his victory over Qi, combined his forces and diverted the river to flood the Zhao capital.
units.literal: Luan Bu returned from defeating Qi and combined forces to divert water and flood Zhao city.

units.zh: 趙城壞，趙王自殺，邯鄲遂降。
units.en: The walls of Zhao collapsed. The King of Zhao took his own life, and Handan surrendered.
units.literal: Zhao city was breached. King Zhao committed suicide. Handan surrendered.

units.zh: 趙幽王絕後。
units.en: The line of King You of Zhao was thus extinguished.
units.literal: The line of King Zhao You was extinguished.

units.zh: 太史公曰：國之將興，必有禎祥，君子用而小人退。
units.en: The Grand Historian remarks: When a state is about to rise, auspicious signs are sure to appear—the worthy are given office and the petty retreat.
units.literal: The Grand Historian says: When a state is about to flourish, there will certainly be auspicious omens, the worthy are employed and the petty withdraw.

units.zh: 國之將亡，賢人隱，亂臣貴。
units.en: When a state is about to fall, the wise withdraw into seclusion and the treacherous are elevated.
units.literal: When a state is about to perish, the worthy hide themselves and traitors are honored.

units.zh: 使楚王戊毋刑申公，遵其言，趙任防與先生，豈有篡殺之謀，為天下僇哉？
units.en: Had King Wu of Chu not punished Master Shen but heeded his counsel, and had Zhao entrusted its affairs to Master Fangyu, how could there have been conspiracies of usurpation and bloodshed, bringing shame upon the realm?
units.literal: If King Wu of Chu had not punished Master Shen and had followed his counsel, and if Zhao had employed Master Fangyu, how could there have been plots of usurpation and murder, bringing disgrace upon the realm?

units.zh: 賢人乎，賢人乎！
units.en: O, the worthy! O, the worthy!
units.literal: Ah, the worthy! Ah, the worthy!

units.zh: 非質有其內，惡能用之哉？
units.en: Without possessing true substance within oneself, how can one make use of the worthy?
units.literal: If one does not possess the substance within, how can one employ it?

units.zh: 甚矣，「安危在出令，存亡在所任」，誠哉是言也！
units.en: How profoundly true is the saying: 'Whether a state knows security or peril depends on the decrees it issues; whether it survives or perishes depends on whom it appoints'—these words ring true indeed!
units.literal: How true it is that 'security and danger lie in issuing commands, survival and extinction lie in whom one employs'—truly this saying is correct!

units.zh: 孝文皇帝四男：竇皇后生孝景帝、梁孝王武，諸姬生代孝王參、梁懷王揖。
units.en: Emperor Wen had four sons. Empress Dou gave birth to Emperor Jing and King Xiao Wu of Liang; other consorts bore King Xiao Can of Dai and King Huai Yi of Liang.
units.literal: Emperor Xiaowen had four sons: Empress Dou bore Emperor Xiaojing and King Xiao Wu of Liang; various concubines bore King Xiao Can of Dai and King Huai Yi of Liang.

units.zh: 及聞孝王死，竇太后泣極哀，不食，曰：「帝果殺吾子！」
units.en: When news came that King Xiao had died, Empress Dou wept with extreme grief and would not eat, saying, “The emperor has truly killed my son!”
units.literal: When she heard the Filial King had died, Empress Dou wept with extreme grief, did not eat, saying: “The emperor truly killed my son!”

units.zh: 太后亦然。
units.en: The empress dowager felt the same way.
units.literal: The empress dowager was likewise so.

units.zh: 孝王，太后少子，愛之，賞賜不可勝道。
units.en: As the empress dowager’s youngest son, King Xiao was her favorite; the gifts showered on him were beyond counting.
units.literal: The Filial King was the empress dowager’s youngest son; she loved him; rewards and gifts could not be reckoned.

units.zh: 太后泣曰：「帝殺吾子！」
units.en: The empress dowager wept, “The emperor has murdered my son!”
units.literal: The empress dowager wept, saying: “The emperor has killed my son!”

units.zh: 以太后故，入則侍帝同輦，出則同車遊獵上林中。
units.en: For his mother’s sake he rode with the emperor in the same palanquin when they went in, and hunted together in the imperial park in the same chariot when they went out.
units.literal: Because of the empress dowager, when entering he attended the emperor sharing the same palanquin; when going out he rode the same chariot hunting in Shanglin Park.

units.zh: 十一月，上廢栗太子，太后心欲以梁王為嗣。
units.en: That November the emperor deposed Crown Prince Li; the empress dowager privately hoped that the king of Liang might succeed him.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, the sovereign deposed Crown Prince Li; the empress dowager in her heart wished to make the King of Liang heir.

units.zh: 大臣及爰盎等有所關說於帝，太后議格，孝王不敢復言太后以嗣事。
units.en: Ministers led by Yuan Ang remonstrated with the emperor until the dowager’s plan stalled; the king of Liang never again raised the succession with his mother.
units.literal: Great ministers and Yuan Ang and others had explanations they presented to the emperor; the empress dowager’s deliberations were blocked; the Filial King did not dare again speak to the empress dowager about the heir matter.

units.zh: 梁王恐，乃使韓安國因長公主謝罪太后，然後得釋。
units.en: Terrified, he sent Han Anguo to plead through the Eldest Princess before the empress dowager, and only then escaped worse punishment.
units.literal: The King of Liang was afraid; then he sent Han Anguo through the Eldest Princess to beg forgiveness of the empress dowager; afterward he obtained release.

units.zh: 然後太后、帝皆大喜，相與泣，復如故。
units.en: Then the empress dowager and the emperor were both greatly pleased; they wept together and were reconciled as before.
units.literal: Afterward the empress dowager and the emperor were both greatly pleased; they wept together with each other and returned as before.

units.zh: 孝王慈孝，每聞太后病，口不能食，常欲留長安侍太后。
units.en: The king was devoted to his mother: whenever he heard she was unwell he lost his appetite and longed to stay in Chang’an to nurse her.
units.literal: The Filial King was kind and filial; every time he heard the empress dowager was ill, his mouth could not eat; he always wished to stay in Chang’an to attend the empress dowager.

units.zh: 太后亦愛之。
units.en: She loved him in return.
units.literal: The empress dowager also loved him.

units.zh: 奏之太后，太后乃說，為帝壹餐。
units.en: When this was laid before the empress dowager she relented and took a single meal for her son’s sake.
units.literal: They presented it to the empress dowager; the empress dowager then was pleased and for the emperor ate one meal.

units.zh: 又嘗令左右誦漢書，臥而聽之，至蒯通說韓信曰「相君之背，貴不可言」，寶應蹶然起曰「可謂智士」。
units.en: He once had his attendants read the Book of Han aloud while he listened from his couch. When they reached Kuai Tong's advice to Han Xin—"If you turn your back on Han, your rank will be beyond words"—Baoying sprang up and exclaimed, "A truly wise man!"
units.literal: He once had his attendants recite the Book of Han while he listened lying down. When they came to Kuai Tong telling Han Xin, "When I read your back, your nobility is beyond words," Baoying sprang up and said, "He can truly be called a wise man."

units.zh: 沈炯 虞荔 弟寄 馬樞
units.en: Shen Jiong; Yu Li; younger brother Ji; Ma Shu
units.literal: Shen Jiong; Yu Li; younger brother Ji; Ma Shu

units.zh: 寄正色曰：「覆酈驕韓，未足稱智；
units.en: Ji answered sternly: "A man whose schemes destroyed Li Yiji and filled Han Xin with arrogance hardly deserves to be called wise.
units.literal: Ji said sternly: "Bringing ruin upon Li Yiji and making Han Xin arrogant is not enough to be called wisdom;

units.zh: 以中大夫令免為車騎將軍屯飛狐，故楚相蘇意為將軍屯句注，將軍張武屯北地，河內太守周亞夫為將軍次細柳，宗正劉禮為將軍次霸上，祝茲侯徐厲為將軍次棘門，以備胡。
units.en: He appointed Court Gentleman Ling Mian as Chariot and Cavalry General stationed at Feihu Pass, former Chu Chancellor Su Yi as general stationed at Gouzhu Pass, General Zhang Wu stationed at Beidi, Hedong Governor Zhou Yafu as general stationed at Xiliu, Imperial Kinsman Liu Li as general stationed at Bashang, and Marquis Xu Li of Zhuzi as general stationed at Jimen, all to defend against the Xiongnu.
units.literal: He appointed Court Gentleman Ling Mian as Chariot and Cavalry General stationed at Feihu, former Chu Chancellor Su Yi as general stationed at Gouzhu, General Zhang Wu stationed at Beidi, Hedong Governor Zhou Yafu as general stationed at Xiliu, Imperial Kinsman Liu Li as general stationed at Bashang, and Marquis Xu Li of Zhuzi as general stationed at Jimen, to prepare against the Xiongnu.

units.zh: 令中尉亞夫為車騎將軍，屬國悍為將屯將軍，郎中令張武為復土將軍，發近縣卒萬六千人，發內史卒萬五千人，臧郭穿 復土屬將軍武。
units.en: He appointed Superintendent of the Capital Zhou Yafu as Chariot and Cavalry General, Protector of Dependent States Han as Garrison General, and Palace Assistant Zhang Wu as Restorer of Soil General. He mobilized 16,000 troops from nearby counties and 15,000 from the Capital District; excavating the outer burial enclosure and covering it with earth was assigned to General Wu.
units.literal: He commanded Superintendent of the Capital Zhou Yafu to be Chariot and Cavalry General, Protector of the Dependent States Han to be Garrison General, Palace Assistant Zhang Wu to be Restorer of Soil General, mobilizing 16,000 troops from nearby counties and 15,000 troops from the Capital District; excavating the outer burial enclosure and covering it with earth was assigned to General Wu.

units.zh: 及景帝即位，錯為御史大夫，說上曰：「昔高帝初定天下，昆弟少，諸子弱，大封同姓，故孽子悼惠王王齊七十二城，庶弟元王王楚四十城，兄子王吳五十餘城。
units.en: When Emperor Jing came to the throne, Chao Cuo became Imperial Counselor. He urged the emperor, "When Gaozu first settled the realm, he had few brothers and his sons were young, so he gave large fiefs to men of his own surname. Thus King Daohui, his son by a concubine, ruled Qi with seventy-two cities; King Yuan, his younger half-brother, ruled Chu with forty cities; and his nephew ruled Wu with more than fifty cities.
units.literal: When Emperor Jing took the throne, Cuo became Grandee Secretary. He urged the emperor, "When Gaozu first settled the realm, his brothers were few and his sons were young, so he made large grants to men of his own surname. Thus King Daohui, his son by a concubine, ruled Qi with seventy-two cities; King Yuan, his younger half-brother, ruled Chu with forty cities; and his elder brother's son ruled Wu with more than fifty cities.

units.zh: 楚元王子、淮南三王或不沐洗十餘年，怨入骨髓，欲壹有所出久矣，寡人未得諸王之意，未敢聽。
units.en: Among the sons of King Yuan of Chu and the three kings of Huainan, some have gone more than ten years without washing or bathing. Resentment runs to their marrow, and they have long wanted one chance to vent it; I have not yet learned the princes’ intentions and have not dared heed them.
units.literal: Among the sons of King Yuan of Chu and the three kings of Huainan, some have gone more than ten years without washing or bathing; resentment runs to their marrow, and they have long wanted a single chance to let it out. I have not yet learned the princes' intentions and have not dared heed them.

units.zh: 上歸櫟陽，五日一朝太公。
units.en: The emperor returned to Queyang. He visited the Duke of Tai every five days.
units.literal: The emperor returned to Queyang. He visited the Duke of Tai every five days.

units.zh: 今上尊太公曰太上皇。」
units.en: Now I honor the Duke of Tai as Taishang Huang."
units.literal: Now I honor the Duke of Tai as Taishang Huang."

units.zh: 太公雖父， 人臣也。
units.en: The Duke of Tai is father, but is a subject.
units.literal: The Duke of Tai is father, but is a subject.

units.zh: 皇帝雖子，人主也；
units.en: The emperor is son, but is the ruler.
units.literal: The emperor is son, but is the ruler.

units.zh: 秋七月癸卯，太上皇崩，葬萬年。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn on the day guimao, the Taishang Huang passed away and was buried at Wannian.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on the day guimao, the Taishang Huang passed away and was buried at Wannian.

units.zh: 八月，令諸侯王皆立太上皇廟于國都。
units.en: In the eighth month, he commanded all feudal lords to establish Taishang Huang temples in their capitals.
units.literal: In the eighth month, he commanded all feudal lords to establish Taishang Huang temples in their capitals.

units.zh: 太公家令說太公曰：「天亡二日，土亡二王。
units.en: The Duke of Tai's household steward advised the Duke of Tai: "Heaven has no two suns, earth has no two kings.
units.literal: The Duke of Tai's household steward advised the Duke of Tai: "Heaven has no two suns, earth has no two kings.

units.zh: 後上朝，太公擁彗，迎門卻行。
units.en: Later when the emperor came to court, the Duke of Tai held a broom and went backwards to meet him at the gate.
units.literal: Later when the emperor came to court, the Duke of Tai held a broom and went backwards to meet him at the gate.

units.zh: 上大驚，下扶太公。
units.en: The emperor was greatly shocked and got down to support the Duke of Tai.
units.literal: The emperor was greatly shocked and got down to support the Duke of Tai.

units.zh: 太公曰：「帝，人主，奈何以我亂天下法！」
units.en: The Duke of Tai said: "The emperor is the ruler of men. How can you disorder the world's laws for my sake!"
units.literal: The Duke of Tai said: "The emperor is the ruler of men. How can you disorder the world's laws for my sake!"

units.zh: 前日天下大亂，兵革並起，萬民苦 殃，朕親被堅執銳，自帥士卒，犯危難，平暴亂，立諸侯，偃兵息民，天下大安，此皆太公之教訓也。
units.en: Previously the world was in great disorder, weapons and armor rose together, and the people suffered calamity. I personally wore armor and grasped sharp weapons, personally led the officers and soldiers, faced danger and difficulty, pacified violent disorder, established the feudal lords, laid down arms and gave the people rest, and brought great peace to the world. This is all due to the teaching and instruction of the Taigong.
units.literal: Previously the world was in great disorder, weapons and armor rose together, the ten thousand people suffered calamity. I personally wore armor and grasped sharp weapons, personally led the officers and soldiers, faced danger and difficulty, pacified violent disorder, established the feudal lords, laid down arms and rested the people, the world is greatly peaceful. This is all due to the Duke of Tai's teaching and instruction.

units.zh: 諸王、通侯、將軍、群卿、大夫已尊朕為皇帝，而太公未有 號。
units.en: The various kings, noble marquises, generals, ministers, and grandees have honored me as emperor, but the Duke of Tai has no title.
units.literal: The various kings, noble marquises, generals, ministers, and grandees have honored me as emperor, but the Duke of Tai has no title.

units.zh: 上奉玉卮為太上皇壽，曰：「始大人常以臣亡賴，不能治產業，不如仲力。
units.en: The emperor raised a jade goblet to toast the Taishang Huang, saying: "At first, Father often said that I was worthless and could not manage property, unlike my elder brother Zhong in ability.
units.literal: The emperor held a jade goblet to toast the Taishang Huang, saying: "At first, father often said that I was worthless and could not manage property, unlike brother Zhong in strength.

units.zh: 已下，皇太子群臣皆反至太上皇廟。
units.en: After descending, the imperial crown prince and ministers all returned to the Taishang Huang temple.
units.literal: After descending, the imperial crown prince and ministers all returned to the Taishang Huang temple.

units.zh: 豐公，蓋太上皇父。
units.en: Lord of Feng — that is, the father of the Grand Emperor Father.
units.literal: Lord of Feng — that is, the father of the Grand Emperor Father.

units.zh: 趙王遂亦陰使匈奴與連兵。
units.en: King Zhao Sui likewise sent secret word to the Xiongnu to join forces.
units.literal: King Zhao Sui also secretly sent to the Xiongnu to link armies.

units.zh: 高皇帝親垂功德，建立諸侯，幽王、悼惠王絕無後，孝文皇帝哀憐加惠，王幽王子遂，悼惠王子卬等，令奉其先王宗廟，為漢藩國，德配天地，明並日月。
units.en: Gaozu established the kingdoms. When the lines of King You of Zhao and King Daohui of Qi had been cut off, Emperor Wen compassionately made You’s son Sui, Daohui’s son Ang, and others kings so that they could tend their forefathers’ shrines and serve as Han’s outer bulwarks. His virtue matched Heaven and Earth, and his brilliance equaled the sun and moon.
units.literal: The August Emperor Gaozu personally bestowed merit and virtue by establishing the princes. When the lines of King You of Zhao and King Daohui of Qi had been cut off without successors, Emperor Xiaowen took pity and extended his grace, making King You's son Sui, King Daohui's son Ang, and others kings so that they could maintain their forefathers' ancestral temples and serve as Han's outer bulwarks—his virtue matched Heaven and Earth, and his brilliance equaled the sun and moon.

units.zh: 及前二年，趙王有罪，削其常山郡。
units.en: In the year before last, the King of Zhao was found guilty and his Changshan commandery was stripped.
units.literal: In the year before last, the King of Zhao was found guilty and his Changshan commandery was stripped.

units.zh: 發使遺諸侯書曰：「吳王劉濞敬問膠西王、膠東王、菑川王、濟南王、趙王、楚王、淮南王、衡山王、廬江王、故長沙王子：幸教！
units.en: His messengers carried a manifesto: “The king of Wu Liu Bi greets the kings of Jiaoxi, Jiaodong, Zichuan, Jinan, Zhao, Chu, Huainan, Hengshan, Lujiang, and the heir of old Changsha—may you instruct me!
units.literal: He sent envoys bearing a letter to the princes: “Liu Bi, King of Wu, respectfully inquires of the kings of Jiaoxi, Jiaodong, Zichuan, Jinan, Zhao, Chu, Huainan, Hengshan, Lujiang, and the son of the former King of Changsha: I beg your counsel!

units.zh: 齊諸王與趙王定河間、河內，或入臨晉關，或與寡人會雒陽；
units.en: let the Qi princes and the king of Zhao take Hejian and Henei—some to force Linjin Pass, others to meet me at Luoyang;
units.literal: the kings of Qi with the King of Zhao shall secure Hejian and Henei, either enter Linjin Pass or rendezvous with me at Luoyang;

units.zh: 燕王、趙王故與胡王有約，燕王北定代、雲中，轉胡眾入蕭關，走長安，匡正天下，以安高廟。
units.en: Yan and Zhao long ago pledged the steppe lords: Yan shall pacify Dai and Yunzhong in the north, swing the nomad horse through Xiaoguan toward Chang’an, set the realm right, and guard Gaozu’s shrine.
units.literal: the Kings of Yan and Zhao formerly had covenants with the Hu king—the King of Yan shall secure north Dai and Yunzhong, wheel the Hu hosts through Xiaoguan toward Chang'an, rectify the realm, and settle the Founder Temple.

units.zh: 今乃與楚王戊、趙王遂、膠西王卬、濟南王辟光、菑川王賢、膠東王雄渠約從謀反，為逆無道，起兵以危宗廟，賊殺大臣及漢使者，迫劫萬民，伐殺無罪，燒殘民家，掘其丘壟，甚為虐暴。
units.en: Now he has allied with Liu Wu of Chu, Liu Sui of Zhao, Liu Ang of Jiaoxi, Liu Piguang of Jinan, Liu Xian of Zichuan, and Liu Xiongqu of Jiaodong to plot rebellion. These lawless traitors menace the temples, murder ministers and envoys, coerce the people, kill the innocent, burn their homes, and dig open their graves. Their cruelty is monstrous.
units.literal: Now he has joined with Liu Wu, king of Chu, Liu Sui, king of Zhao, Liu Ang, king of Jiaoxi, Liu Piguang, king of Jinan, Liu Xian, king of Zichuan, and Liu Xiongqu, king of Jiaodong, in an alliance to plot rebellion. Lawless in their treason, they raised troops to endanger the ancestral temples, murdered great ministers and Han envoys, coerced the people, slaughtered the innocent, burned commoners' homes, and dug open their tombs—utterly cruel and violent.

units.zh: 酈將軍攻趙，十月而下之，趙王自殺。
units.en: General Li took Zhao after a ten-month campaign, and the king of Zhao killed himself.
units.literal: General Li attacked Zhao and took it after ten months; the King of Zhao committed suicide.

units.zh: 膠西、膠東、菑川、濟南、楚、趙亦皆反，發兵西。
units.en: Jiaoxi, Jiaodong, Zichuan, Jinan, Chu, and Zhao rose as well, each sending armies toward the west.
units.literal: Jiaoxi, Jiaodong, Zichuan, Jinan, Chu, and Zhao likewise rebelled and raised troops westward.

units.zh: 及北鄉侯立，遷太傅，與太尉東萊劉喜參錄尚書事。
units.en: When the Marquis of Beixiang acceded, Feng Shi became grand tutor and, with Grand Commandant Liu Xi of Donglai, shared supervision of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: When the marquis of Beixiang was established, he was transferred to grand tutor, with grand commandant Liu Xi of Donglai jointly recording Masters of Writing affairs.

units.zh: 順帝既立，石與喜皆以阿黨閻顯、江京等策免，復為衛尉。
units.en: When Emperor Shun took the throne, Feng Shi and Liu Xi were cashiered for colluding with Yan Xian and Jiang Jing; Feng Shi later returned as minister of the guards.
units.literal: When Emperor Shun was already established, Shi and Xi both because of currying faction with Yan Xian, Jiang Jing and others were removed by edict; again became minister of the guards.

units.zh: 丁未，太子即皇帝位，尊皇太后薄氏曰太皇太后，皇后曰皇太后。
units.en: On the day Dingwei, the crown prince ascended the imperial throne, honoring Empress Dowager Bo as Grand Empress Dowager and the Empress as Empress Dowager.
units.literal: On the Dingwei day, the crown prince ascended the imperial throne, honoring Empress Dowager Bo as Grand Empress Dowager, and the Empress as Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 夏四月壬午，太皇太后崩。
units.en: On the day Renwu in the fourth month of summer, the Grand Empress Dowager passed away.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, day Renwu: Grand Empress Dowager passed away.

units.zh: 秋九月，皇后薄氏廢。
units.en: In the ninth month of autumn, Empress Bo was deposed.
units.literal: Autumn, ninth month: Empress Bo was deposed.
